title: Provincial Employees Social Security Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Employees Social Security Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and, commencement

PROVINCIAL EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY
PROVINCIAL
EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CIV OF 2002
(An Ordinance
further to amend the Provincial Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965)
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary 29th October, 2002]
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
29-10-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and,
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Provincial Employees'
Social Security (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

5. Amendment of section 22,
W.P. Ordinance No. X of 1965.---In the said Ordinance, in section 22,---
(a) in
subsection (4), for the words "the self-assessment scheme remains in
operation the words "of two years" shall be substituted; and
(b)
after subsection (4), the following new subsection (5) shall be added, namely:-
"(5) The
number of annual inspections in respect of those establishment which do not opt
for Self-Assessment Scheme shall be restricted to only one which shall be
notified to the establishments in advance and shall, at the maximum, be
restricted to last two years."
